metadata.title: [FEATURE]: API versioning — serve resource endpoints under /v1 with backward-compatible legacy shim and sunset headers
metadata.author: Lang-Akshay

description:
### 🧭 Type of Feature

- [X] Enhancement to existing functionality

---

### 🧭 Epic

**Title:** API versioning for ContextForge — /v1 route namespace with controlled legacy sunset

**Goal:** Serve all resource-management and business-logic endpoints under a stable `/v1` URL prefix while keeping unversioned legacy paths functional during a migration window. Lay the structural foundation for future `/v2` without breaking existing integrations.

**Why now:** ContextForge is approaching broader adoption. Locking route paths behind a version namespace now avoids a more disruptive migration later, and the sunset/deprecation header machinery gives existing clients a clear, RFC-standard signal to migrate before the compatibility shim is removed on **2026-08-04**.

---

### 🧑🏻‍💻 User Story 1 — API client migrating to versioned paths

**As a:** developer integrating against the ContextForge REST API
**I want:** all resource endpoints served under `/v1/` (e.g. `/v1/tools`, `/v1/gateways`, `/v1/servers`)
**So that:** my client can target a stable, versioned base URL and I know exactly when breaking changes will arrive

#### ✅ Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Scenario: Versioned path serves the resource
  Given the gateway is running with default configuration
  When I send GET /v1/tools
  Then I receive a 200 response with the tools list
  And no Deprecation header is present

Scenario: Legacy path still works during migration window
  Given LEGACY_API_ENABLED=true (default)
  When I send GET /tools (unversioned)
  Then I receive a 200 response
  And the response includes header Deprecation: true
  And the response includes header Sunset: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 00:00:00 GMT
  And the response includes a Link header pointing to the /v1 equivalent

Scenario: Legacy shim disabled
  Given LEGACY_API_ENABLED=false
  When I send GET /tools (unversioned)
  Then I receive 404
  And /v1/tools still returns 200
```

---

### 🧑🏻‍💻 User Story 2 — Operator dropping legacy routes after migration

**As a:** platform operator who has migrated all clients to /v1
**I want:** a single env-var knob (`LEGACY_API_ENABLED=false`) to drop the unversioned shim
**So that:** I can enforce that no client accidentally uses the deprecated paths in production

#### ✅ Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Scenario: Legacy routes removed cleanly
  Given LEGACY_API_ENABLED=false
  When the gateway starts
  Then no unversioned resource routes are registered in the router table
  And /v1/* routes are unaffected

Scenario: Protocol and infrastructure paths unaffected
  Given any value of LEGACY_API_ENABLED
  When I request /mcp, /health, /ready, /oauth/*, /.well-known/*, /version
  Then those routes are always present and return their normal responses
  And they never carry Deprecation or Sunset headers
```

---

### 🧑🏻‍💻 User Story 3 — Future version addition

**As a:** ContextForge maintainer adding /v2 endpoints
**I want:** router assembly centralised in `mcpgateway/api/v1/__init__.py` via a `build_v1_router()` factory
**So that:** I can add `mcpgateway/api/v2/__init__.py` with a `build_v2_router()` factory without touching `main.py` beyond a single mount call

#### ✅ Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Scenario: v2 router added without altering v1
  Given a build_v2_router() factory exists in mcpgateway/api/v2/__init__.py
  When I mount it in main.py with prefix /v2
  Then /v1/* routes are unaffected
  And /v2/* routes are served correctly
```

---

### 📐 Design Sketch

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Client -->|request| App[FastAPI app]

    App --> UnversionedRoutes["Unversioned routes (always-on)\n/mcp · /health · /ready · /oauth\n/.well-known · /version · /static\n/favicon.ico · /api/logs"]

    App -->|prefix /v1| V1Router["build_v1_router()\nmcpgateway/api/v1/__init__.py"]
    V1Router --> AssembleRouters["_assemble_routers()\nshared feature-flag logic"]
    AssembleRouters --> ResourceRouters["tools · resources · prompts\ngateways · servers · roots\nmetrics · tags · export/import\nadmin · auth · teams · tokens\nrbac · a2a · observability\ncancellation · toolops · reverse-proxy"]

    App -->|prefix / — only when LEGACY_API_ENABLED=true| LegacyRouter["build_legacy_router()\nreuses _assemble_routers()"]
    LegacyRouter --> DeprecationMiddleware["DeprecationHeadersMiddleware\nDeprecation: true\nSunset: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 00:00:00 GMT\nLink: </v1/{path}>; rel=successor-version"]
```

**Endpoint classification summary**

| Group               | Canonical path                                                        | Feature flag                             |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Tools               | `/v1/tools/**`                                                      | always-on                                |
| Resources           | `/v1/resources/**`                                                  | always-on                                |
| Prompts             | `/v1/prompts/**`                                                    | always-on                                |
| Gateways            | `/v1/gateways/**`                                                   | always-on                                |
| Servers             | `/v1/servers/**`                                                    | always-on                                |
| Roots               | `/v1/roots/**`                                                      | always-on                                |
| Metrics             | `/v1/metrics/**`                                                    | always-on                                |
| Tags                | `/v1/tags/**`                                                       | always-on                                |
| Export / Import     | `/v1/export`, `/v1/import`                                        | always-on                                |
| Admin UI & API      | `/v1/admin/**`                                                      | `MCPGATEWAY_ADMIN_API_ENABLED`         |
| A2A                 | `/v1/a2a/**`                                                        | `MCPGATEWAY_A2A_ENABLED`               |
| Auth / Teams / RBAC | `/v1/auth/**`, `/v1/teams/**`, `/v1/tokens/**`, `/v1/rbac/**` | `EMAIL_AUTH_ENABLED`                   |
| Observability       | `/v1/observability/**`                                              | `OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED`                |
| LLM Chat / Config   | `/v1/llmchat/**`, `/v1/llm/**`                                    | `MCPGATEWAY_LLMCHAT_ENABLED`           |
| Reverse Proxy       | `/v1/reverse-proxy/**`                                              | `MCPGATEWAY_REVERSE_PROXY_ENABLED`     |
| Tool Cancellation   | `/v1/cancellation/**`                                               | `MCPGATEWAY_TOOL_CANCELLATION_ENABLED` |
| ToolOps             | `/v1/toolops/**`                                                    | `TOOLOPS_ENABLED`                      |

**Not versioned (mounted at root, never receive deprecation headers)**

| Group                 | Path                                                  | Reason                                                   |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Health probes         | `/health`, `/ready`, `/health/security`         | Infrastructure liveness; must remain stable              |
| MCP transport         | `/mcp`                                              | MCP spec — path fixed by spec                           |
| Internal bridge       | `/_internal/mcp/transport`                          | Trusted internal bridge                                  |
| OAuth 2.0             | `/oauth/**`                                         | RFC 6749 standard location                               |
| Well-known URIs       | `/.well-known/**`, `/servers/{id}/.well-known/**` | RFC 8615 / 9116 / 9728                                   |
| Version / diagnostics | `/version`                                          | Not a resource API                                       |
| LLM proxy             | `{LLM_API_PREFIX}` (default `/v1`)                | Runtime-configurable; cannot nest inside gateway `/v1` |

---

### 🔗 MCP Standards Check

- [X] Change adheres to current MCP specifications
- [X] No breaking changes to existing MCP-compliant integrations — `/mcp` transport path is unchanged

- Protocol-level routes (`/mcp`, `/oauth`, `/.well-known`) are intentionally excluded from versioning per spec requirements

---

### 🔄 Alternatives Considered

**Header-based versioning (`Accept: application/vnd.contextforge.v1+json`)** — rejected. URL-based versioning is simpler to proxy, cache, and document; header versioning requires all clients to set custom headers and complicates curl/browser testing.

**No legacy shim** — rejected. Too disruptive for integrations that cannot update immediately. RFC 8594 sunset headers with a 15-month window (`LEGACY_API_SUNSET_DATE=Wed, 04 Aug 2026 00:00:00 GMT`) give clients adequate notice.

**Single flat router in `main.py`** — current state, rejected going forward. A `build_v1_router()` factory keeps `main.py` clean and makes adding `/v2` a single mount call.

---

### 📓 Additional Context

- **Legacy config knobs:**
  ```env
  LEGACY_API_ENABLED=true                          # default: true — set false to drop shim
  LEGACY_API_SUNSET_DATE=Wed, 04 Aug 2026 00:00:00 GMT
  ```
- Deprecation headers follow [RFC 8594](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8594) (`Deprecation`, `Sunset`) and [RFC 8288](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288) (`Link: rel=successor-version`).
- Breaking change: all previously unversioned paths (`/tools`, `/resources`, `/prompts`, `/gateways`, `/servers`, `/roots`, `/metrics`, `/tags`, `/a2a`, `/admin`, `/auth`, `/teams`, `/tokens`, `/rbac`, `/observability`, `/cancellation`, `/toolops`, `/reverse-proxy`, `/export`, `/import`) move canonically to `/v1`. Legacy shim is on by default until sunset date.
- Admin redirect paths in `mcpgateway/admin.py` updated to `/v1/admin/*`.
- All e2e, integration, fuzz, and load tests updated to use `/v1` prefixed paths.
